verdict.rationale: Stripe pushes real-time events to webhook endpoints, Amazon EventBridge and Azure Event Grid, so you can trigger your own actions on events, but you have to write the handling code. The only rule-builder in the evidence is Kyber, a third-party Stripe App that offers no-code automations on Stripe events inside the Dashboard (e.g., notify Slack when a dispute opens). Built-in automation is limited to fixed behaviors such as Smart Retries. Missing for 10: a native first-party rule/automation builder, user-defined rule conditions and actions without code, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
